冰山逆徒以下犯上（冰山逆徒以下犯上（第22页）这种窥视应该只是看到某个零碎画面，与婉清那种几乎看完全局的截然不同。
既然她不认识自己……那为何一上来就如此反常？和窥视的未来有关？正想着，玉倾心却又有了动作。
她抬起那只完美无瑕的玉足，直接踩在了墨羽的大腿上。
“自相见至今，已过去近半个时辰，你我已然足够熟稔了。”
她足尖微微用力，一股霸道冰冷的仙力顺势侵入墨羽体内。
若是寻常天仙，被这股力量一压，怕是当场便会筋骨寸断、动弹不得。
但墨羽却如沐春风，没有受到任何影响。
他唯一能感觉到的，便是她踩在腿上的那只脚。
隔着衣料传来丝丝沁骨的微凉，让人忍不住想将其抓在手里肆意把玩。
墨羽见她终于露出了獠牙，本想直接掀翻她，扒下裤子打一顿屁股好好审问一番。
“师尊，您是不是感觉浑身无力，仙力滞涩，无法调用分毫了？”
“刚刚徒儿对您下了点小毒，您的仙力，暂时被封印了。”
难怪刚才她靠得那么近朝自己吐气，原来是下毒啊。
那点毒素，入体的瞬间估计就被真龙血脉吞噬，或者被天毒珠吸光了，他甚至连点感觉都没有。
不过，为了看看这冰山美人到底想玩什么花样。
肩头，隐匿着的桃夭夭激动得难以自持，双腿死死绞紧。
徒儿用毒药暗算师尊，强行逼迫就范！

玉倾心见状，嘴角的嘲弄愈发明显。
“师尊，您还是乖乖认命，老老实实给我按腿吧。”
言罢，她素手一探，一把抓起墨羽的手，强行按在了自己小腿之上。
光滑到不可思议，又极度柔软水润，堪称极品中的极品！
以后有机会，一定要让所有的娘子都学学这门功法！
玉倾心低着头，清冷的眸子里满是浓浓的鄙夷。
“嘴上说得冠冕堂皇，这一上手，还不是摸个不停。”
面上虽然鄙夷，可由于魂契相连，墨羽清晰地感知到，她内心的满足感简直要溢出来了。
他竟然不怕？是因为仗着外面还有一堆实力高强的女人吗？呵，即便外头那些女人再强，也救不了他。
大不了，自己也摇人便是了，玉族可不惧任何人。
清冷的目光缓缓下移，顿时愣住了。
那张万载不化的冰山仙颜上，瞬间浮现出一抹嫌恶之色，冷冷吐出两字。
话虽说得难听，可她那双冷眸却像长在了上面似的，根本没挪开，偷偷地打量着。
不能再这么陪她玩下去了，不然自己真要把持不住，把她就地正法了。
他反手攥住她的脚踝，猛地往上一提。
整个人瞬间被墨羽倒提了起来，头下脚上地挂在了半空中。
可仙力刚一运转，便惊骇地发现，自己的仙力竟被禁锢住了！
挣扎间，月白色的裙摆失去仙力保护，顺着修长的玉腿倏然滑落。
墨羽目光在上面停了一瞬，惊得瞪大了双眼。
裙摆之下，竟是一件深色的纯白亵裤。

Chapter 1154: Iceberg Rebels (Page 1)
This kind of peek should only see a fragmented picture, which is completely different from Wanqing's kind of almost seeing the whole picture.
Since she doesn't know herself... then why is she so abnormal from the beginning? Something to do with the peek into the future? Just as she was thinking about it, Yu Qingxin made another move.
She raised her flawless jade foot and stepped directly on Mo Yu's thigh.
"Nearly half an hour has passed since we met, and you and I are already very familiar with each other."
She exerted slight pressure on her toes, and a domineering and cold immortal power invaded Mo Yu's body.
If he were an ordinary immortal, if he were pressed by this force, his muscles and bones would probably be broken on the spot and he would be unable to move.
But Mo Yu felt like a spring breeze and was not affected in any way.
The only thing he could feel was her foot on his leg.
There was a slight chill that penetrated the fabric, making people want to grab it in their hands and play with it.
Seeing that she finally showed her fangs, Mo Yu wanted to overturn her, take off her pants, spank her and interrogate her.
"Master, do you feel that your whole body is weak, your immortal power is stagnant, and you cannot use it at all?"
"My disciple just gave you a little poison, and your immortal power was temporarily sealed."
No wonder she was so close and breathed on him just now. It turned out to be poison.
That bit of poison was probably swallowed up by the True Dragon's bloodline or absorbed by the Sky Poison Pearl the moment it entered his body. He didn't even feel it at all.
However, in order to see what tricks this iceberg beauty wants to play.
Tao Yaoyao, who was hiding on her shoulders, was so excited that she couldn't control herself, and her legs were tightly tightened.
The disciple used poison to plot against the master and forced him to submit!
When Yu Qingxin saw this, the mocking at the corner of her mouth became more and more obvious.
"Master, you'd better accept your fate and press my legs honestly."
After saying that, she reached out with her bare hands, grabbed Mo Yu's hand, and pressed it forcefully on her calf.
Incredibly smooth, yet extremely soft and hydrating, it’s the best of the best!
If you have the opportunity in the future, you must let all ladies learn this technique!
Yu Qingxin lowered her head, her cold eyes full of deep contempt.
"You talk loud and clear, but when you get started, you don't just touch it all the time."
Although she looked disdainful, due to the soul bond, Mo Yu could clearly feel that the satisfaction in her heart was almost overflowing.
He's not afraid? Is it because there are still a bunch of powerful women outside? Oh, no matter how strong those women outside are, they can't save him.
At worst, you can just sway others yourself. The Jade Clan is not afraid of anyone.
His cold eyes slowly moved down, and he was suddenly stunned.
A look of disgust instantly appeared on that immortal face, and he uttered two words coldly.
Although the words were harsh, her cold eyes seemed to be fixed on it, and she didn't move away at all, looking at him secretly.
I can't keep playing with her like this, otherwise I will really lose control and execute her on the spot.
He grabbed her ankle with his backhand and lifted it up sharply.
The whole person was instantly lifted upside down by Mo Yu, and his head and feet were hung in mid-air.
But as soon as the immortal power was activated, he was horrified to find that his own immortal power was actually imprisoned!
During the struggle, the moon-white skirt lost the protection of its immortal power and suddenly slipped down her slender jade legs.
Mo Yu's eyes stopped on it for a moment, and his eyes widened in shock.
Under the hem of the skirt was a pair of dark pure white pants.
